purpose: Contract for compound rainfall, urban drainage and tidal flooding scenarios in the HCMC digital twin

citywideScope.coverage: Entire official Ho Chi Minh City administrative extent
citywideScope.strategy: Catchment-based multi-resolution 1D/2D model with citywide overview tiles and finer meshes for recurrent-flood basins
citywideScope.pilotRole: Thao Dien is the first calibration and interaction slice, not the spatial limit of the product

pilotArea.sceneRequirement: Expand the current 3D extent north/east before hydraulic meshing
evidence: HCMC Technical Infrastructure Management Centre flood early-warning report
HCMC People's Council report of the 2025-10-08 rain-plus-tide event

excludedPilotArea.name: Nguyen Hue - Bach Dang - Ba Son
excludedPilotArea.reason: Not representative of recurrent flooding; retain as an urban visualisation scene unless event-specific observations support a flood layer

truthPolicy.publicDemo: Scenario/proxy until calibrated against observed water depth and duration
truthPolicy.engineering: Requires official drainage, bare-earth elevation, gauges and independent validation
forbidden: Presenting satellite rainfall as street-scale measurement
Using a DSM as if it were a bare-earth DTM
Inventing missing drain capacity or inlet elevations
Publishing uncalibrated depth as a forecast

boundsFrom: approved design return periods under TCVN 7957:2023
rain.ui: Select an observed event or approved return period; show total, duration, peak intensity and source

boundsFrom: Phu An and Nha Be gauge records on a declared vertical datum
tide.ui: Select an observed/approved hydrograph or warning level; never enter an arbitrary water level

compound.rule: Observed rain and tide pairs retain their timestamps; synthetic pairs require an approved joint-probability method
compound.stressTest: A worst-case combination is allowed only when explicitly labelled stress test, not forecast

solver.coupling: Exchange flow at inlets/manholes; downstream stage hydrograph carries tide/river level
solver.visualisation: Time-indexed depth and velocity textures streamed to Three.js/WebGPU

warningPolicy.rule: Do not hard-code warning thresholds until the city-approved matrix and vertical datum are registered

qualityGates.label: Kịch bản minh họa — chưa hiệu chỉnh
